probes.label: predict default is mu, log sigma and log df
probes.detail: type='link' is mu, log sigma and log df. Identity matches mu to 0.00e+00; exp matches sigma to 0.00e+00 and df to 0.00e+00.

probes.label: StudentTLSS logLik is the t density
probes.detail: logLik() = -2856.382296 matches the t density at the fitted mu, sigma and df to 7.28e-12.

probes.label: sigma is the t scale, not the standard deviation
probes.detail: mean sigma = 1.351, mean df = 4.73, implied sd = sigma * sqrt(df / (df - 2)) = 1.778, residual sd = 1.784.

probes.label: offset is on the link scale
probes.detail: offset is on the link: sigma offset 0.3813 against log(mean sigma) 0.3813; df offset 1.5542 against log(mean df) 1.5542.

probes.label: a non-finite y is refused
probes.detail: Column 'y' contains 1 NaN value(s) out of 1500 (first at row 0). Fitting and prediction require finite values; pass na_action='impute' to the fit (median fill plus a missing-value indicator term, replayed when predicting new rows), na_action='impute_model' when the other covariates predict the column (the same, with a model-based fill), or na_action='omit' (drop those rows), or drop or impute them

probes.label: glmboost does not take StudentTLSS
probes.detail: StudentTLSS is a distributional family (parameters: mu, sigma, df). glmboost() fits one predictor. Use glmboostLSS() or gamboostLSS(), for example mb.gamboostLSS(formula, data, family=mb.StudentTLSS()).
